DIAGNOSIS READY: C. difficile-associated diarrhea (CDAD). 

The clinical picture of severe watery diarrhea (9 episodes in 48 hours), lower abdominal cramping, and recent exposure to levofloxacin for pneumonia is highly diagnostic for *C. difficile* colitis, despite the pending toxin assay. I will hold off on further testing and proceed with empiric treatment based on these strong clinical indicators.
